content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 15.2 already delivers the Customer-side preferred elements (Sanofi affiliate assignment without consent, Sanofi M&A/successor assignment without consent), and RevMed has no termination right on a Sanofi change of control. The deviation is Section 15.2(a)(ii), which lets RevMed assign the whole Agreement to its Change of Control successor with no Sanofi consent and no competitor bar. One surgical replace splits the sentence: Sanofi's prong is preserved verbatim, RevMed's Change of Control assignment now requires Sanofi's consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), and an express bar on assignment to a Sanofi competitor is added. We targeted preferred rather than fallback because the fallback's "other assignments require consent" would surrender Sanofi's no-consent Affiliate right.
